newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, awaiting UK PSBR data.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, awaiting UK PSBR data.

text.p: UK shares were mixed at the opening on Friday, buoyed by record closes here and in the U.S. but unwilling to make gains ahead of UK economic data.
The FTSE 100 index was 3.2 points lower at 4,194.3 by 0835 GMT with gainers and losers evenly matched. Mid-250 stocks were faring better, up 7.5 points at 4,573.4 to reach an all-time high.
UK blue-chips had leapt to a second record close of the year on Thursday, stopping just short of the 4,200 level after UK interest rates were left unchanged and core inflation slowed.
The record-breaking performance was mirrored in New York.
